lines.t: Tables laden with decay they spread,
Crowds devour what leaves them dead.
Spoiled morsels from hands unclean,
Feeding lies in halls of false esteem.
Turn away from the tainted spread,
Empty hands for truth instead.
Filthy plates, rotten food they serve,
Churches pile what souls don’t deserve.
Push it back, let hunger call,
Pure provision breaks the fall.
Masses chew on poisoned lies,
Doctrines twisted, blinding eyes.
Gluttons stuffed on empty gain,
Chasing shadows, bound in chain.
Shatter dishes, clear the feast,
Find the bread that brings release.
Filthy plates, rotten food they serve,
Churches pile what souls don’t deserve.
Push it back, let hunger call,
Pure provision breaks the fall.
From above comes living fare,
Fills the void, beyond compare.
Leave the rot, embrace the pure,
Humbled hearts forever sure.
Filthy plates, cast them far away,
Rotten food ends this dark day.
Feast on grace, in narrow light,
Satisfied in truth’s pure sight.
